observed: The replacement core starts and accepts Calm, directional and Focus controls.
Collected six fruit through actual keyboard movement, including a detour around rock cells and a corrected missed turn using Focus. Cleared Orchard at score 800 with length 10.
Pressed Enter to travel. Ruin Gates retained length 10 and replenished Focus.
Crossed gate A while the body occupied it after gate B opened; collected the next fruit using Focus at score 900, length 11.
No browser errors or warnings. Requested an explicit visible Normal/Calm mode indicator.

Long held Focus movement reduced the meter to roughly 5–6%; after release, ordinary steering restored it to about 20%. Reported that the 10% restart threshold needs a visible marker/message. These screenshots are taken after key release and do not establish the held-exhaustion state by themselves.
preliminaryChecks.revisionNotes: First compiling mechanics core; final art, campaigns, independent review and final browser acceptance are still pending.

observed: English desktop art displays distinct traffic, log end grain, reeds, frog poses and an airborne shadow.
Using actual keyboard controls, waited for road gaps, changed direction on the road and reached the middle bank with all four lives.
Found that the introductory lesson text covers the frog on the middle bank; requested a renderer correction.
A missed log-edge landing and a mistimed traffic crossing caused ordinary life losses; the traffic collision displayed a release-directions message.
Restart restored four lives, empty homes, a 45-second timer and score zero while retaining the best score. A fresh controlled route reached the bank again.
Two left hops, two forward log landings, waiting on the moving second-row log, and two more forward hops rescued a frog into home 2 at score 530, four lives.
Activated all four Chinese phone touch controls. A forward hop into traffic produced Chinese hit feedback and lost one life.
preliminaryChecks.revisionNotes: Initial final-art candidate. Middle-bank lesson overlap is open; final renderer recheck, landscape and terminal loss acceptance are pending. The screenshots named two-log-landing and recovery-traffic show failed attempts, not successful landings.

observed: Reloaded final art candidate 3f7c954f. Connected body/head/tail, fruit and obstacle silhouettes are clear; Calm mode and the Focus readiness marker are visible.
A fresh actual-keyboard run collected all six Orchard fruit, including obstacle detours and Focus corrections, ending at score 800 and length 10.
Chinese phone Next garden button advanced to Ruin Gates and preserved length 10; Focus replenished.
Landscape fullscreen displayed gate phase and move pips. Passed gate A while the occupied body held it open after B opened.
Continuing into the top border produced a legitimate loss with a Chinese explanation. Restart restored Orchard, length four, full Focus, Normal pace and score zero while retaining best 800.
Activated all seven Chinese touch controls, including Next at a valid transition. An actual canvas swipe turned the snake upward.
Final browser error/warning log was empty.
games.revisionNotes: All final art, fresh Orchard clear, touch travel, gate pass, loss, restart and touch/swipe checks used unchanged 3f7c954f. Earlier mechanics-only core evidence is separately marked preliminary. Independent review approved the same source.
limitations: All three-garden wins are established by automated public-input campaigns; this browser journey cleared Orchard and entered Ruin Gates.
Touch buttons and swipes were driven in desktop Chrome at phone dimensions; no physical touch device or non-Chrome browser was tested.

observed: Completed all three caverns through actual keyboard, visible pointer and touch input; final score 4790. No gameplay state injection was used.
First cavern: keyboard aim, Space/Enter shots and X swaps cleared exposed groups. The guide showed the eventual socket and a screenshot caught the capsule in flight.
The final first-cavern drain completed before the next board loaded. Basalt Gates displayed fixed bolts and new geometry; Hanging Keys displayed distinct suspended groups.
Recovered from a nonmatching shot in Basalt Gates by swapping to clear its support group. The extra capsule drained with the detached group; pressure returned from three to four misses available.
Cleared hanging groups and aimed past fixed bolts. A right-rail bank shot cleared the last Basalt Gates group before the final cavern.
Activated every Chinese phone touch control, including a successful touch-fired match in Hanging Keys. Completed the campaign in Chinese landscape fullscreen.
Restart restored the first cavern, 41 capsules, five misses available and score zero while retaining best 4790.

A separate deliberate nonmatching stack showed one miss remaining, announced an impending pusher move, then displayed the rack partway through movement. Two further nonmatches produced a legitimate safety-line loss with a Chinese explanation.
English desktop, Chinese phone and landscape layouts were checked. Final browser error/warning log was empty.
games.revisionNotes: Full browser campaign, controls, pusher, loss and restart used unchanged 072f775 source. Independent review approved the final expanded 30-test suite at the same runtime revision.
limitations: Touch was driven in desktop Chrome at phone dimensions; no physical touch device or non-Chrome browser was tested.
Automated contact and timing tests provide quantitative physics evidence; screenshots alone do not establish conservation or frame-rate invariance.

Parent source comparison confirms the final correction only changes instructional rendering and status text; the previously tested physics and input paths are unchanged.
Reloaded final ac9e7c76 and repeated the traffic route. The frog is fully visible on the middle bank; instructions now stay in the top HUD and host status.
Checked final English desktop, Chinese phone and Chinese landscape layouts.
A deliberate unsupported landing gave a visible Chinese water-loss/release cue. Further ordinary forward hops depleted the remaining lives and ended at score 90 with a Chinese retry explanation.
Restarted the final source, activated every Chinese touch action, and reached the first road at score 10 with all four frogs, empty homes and retained best 530.
Final browser error/warning log was empty.
